# PITFALLS - 13-Kandinsky-OmniGen-Ovis-HunyuanImage

## KVAE-Image 2.0 Latent Space Incompatibility

**Symptom**: Latent representations generated by one version of the KVAE-Image tokenizer cannot be correctly decoded or used by a diffusion model trained on the other version, leading to corrupted or nonsensical outputs.
**Cause**: The `v2.0` and `v2.1` revisions of KVAE-Image 2.0 have different encoder weights, meaning their latent spaces are not compatible. The `main` branch points to `v2.1`, while `v2.0` must be explicitly requested via `from_pretrained(..., revision="v2.0")`.
**Fix**: Ensure the tokenizer revision matches the training data or model expectations. If using `v2.1` (default `main`), do not mix latents with `v2.0`. Explicitly specify the revision if `v2.0` behavior is required.
**Source**: [https://huggingface.co/kandinskylab/KVAE-2D-2.0]

## KVAE-Video 2.0 Concurrent Stream Interference

**Symptom**: Corrupted video reconstruction or temporal artifacts when processing multiple independent video streams simultaneously.
**Cause**: The KVAE-Video 2.0 t4s16 architecture uses internal block caches for temporal segments. Interleaving independent videos on the same model instance causes cache conflicts.
**Fix**: Do not interleave independent videos on the same model instance. Use one `KVAEVideo` instance per concurrent stream.
**Source**: [https://huggingface.co/kandinskylab/KVAE-3D-2.0-t4s16]

## Kandinsky 5.0 Diffusers Integration Status

**Symptom**: Failure to import `Kandinsky5T2IPipeline` or other Kandinsky 5.0 pipelines from the standard `diffusers` library, or encountering missing class errors.
**Cause**: As of the latest update (11/24/2025), Kandinsky 5.0 is not yet merged into the main `diffusers` repository. The standard library does not contain the necessary pipeline classes.
**Fix**: Use the specific diffusers fork provided by the developers: `pip install git+https://github.com/leffff/diffusers`.
**Source**: [https://huggingface.co/kandinskylab/Kandinsky-5.0-T2I-Lite-sft-Diffusers]

## Kandinsky 5.0 VRAM and Precision Requirements

**Symptom**: Out-of-memory (OOM) errors or failure to load the model on standard consumer GPUs without specific optimizations.
**Cause**: The model is designed to run in `bfloat16` precision. While the full pipeline can run at 24 GB with offloading, standard configurations may exceed lower VRAM limits.
**Fix**: For GPUs with 12 GB of memory, specific optimizations are required: VAE tiling and the use of the NF4 version of Qwen2.5-VL from Bitsandbytes. Additionally, select an appropriate attention engine (`Flash Attention 2`, `Sage Attention`, or `SDPA`) using the `--attention_engine` option.
**Source**: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kandinskylab/kandinsky-5/HEAD/README.md]

## Missing Local VAE and Text Encoder Files for Kandinsky 5.0

**Symptom**: Workflow failure in ComfyUI or local pipelines because the VAE and Text Encoder files are not found in the local model directory.
**Cause**: The local installation only lists the diffusion model file `kandinsky5lite_t2i.safetensors`. The specific local file paths for the Flux VAE and the Qwen2.5-VL/CLIP text encoders are not stated in the provided local folder scan or model files list.
**Fix**: Verify that the Flux VAE and text encoder weights are downloaded and placed in the correct ComfyUI model directories, as they are integral parts of the pipeline but not explicitly listed in the local file inventory.
**Source**: [WORKFLOW_PLAN.md], [MODEL.md]

## Missing Local VAE File for Ovis-Image

**Symptom**: Workflow failure in ComfyUI or local pipelines for Ovis-Image because the VAE file is not found.
**Cause**: The local model files list contains the diffusion model (`ovis_image_bf16.safetensors`) and text encoder (`ovis_2.5.safetensors`), but no VAE file is listed for Ovis-Image.
**Fix**: Ensure a compatible VAE is available in the system or loaded from a path not specified in the local material, as the specific VAE file is not included in the local inventory.
**Source**: [WORKFLOW_PLAN.md]

## Incorrect Model Usage for Image-to-Video (I2V)

**Symptom**: Failure to generate video or incorrect results when attempting to use the Text-to-Image (T2I) model for Image-to-Video (I2V) tasks.
**Cause**: The local environment only contains the T2I model weights (`kandinsky5lite_t2i.safetensors`). The specific I2V model weights are not present in the local file list. Using T2I weights for I2V is not supported.
**Fix**: Do not use the T2I model for I2V tasks. Download the specific I2V model weights (e.g., from `Kandinsky-5.0-I2I-Lite-sft-Diffusers` or video-specific variants) if I2V functionality is required.
**Source**: [WORKFLOW_PLAN.md]
